posts.title: Hosted my first app
posts.description: I recently hosted my app, and let me tell you, it feels nice to make something tangible after years of not being able to code. Several steps led to this point. First, I became proficient in Python and SQL. Then I finally came up with an idea I liked, and pieced many tutorials and docs to be able to create Flask apps confidently. posts.title: Choose to be optimistic
posts.description: I want to encourage others to be optimistic, because I don't know if there is a reward in being pessimistic. posts.title: One more way to discover music you'd like (especially right now)
posts.description: If you would like to own your music, drm-free, and store it on your own disk forever, then you should take a look at Bandcamp. It's a great way to discover new music, too. It's also ethical to artists, because they get a fair 80-85% from sales.
